Times Music Spiritual presents ‘Shree Ganeshay Dheemahi’, the iconic Gananayakaya song
Perfect for morning prayers, Ganpati worship, meditation, or moments when you simply want to slow down, ‘Shree Ganeshay Dheemahi’ helps create a peaceful, focused, and positive atmosphere. The repeated invocation of Lord Ganesha encourages calmness and devotion, making this Ganesh bhajan a beautiful companion throughout Ganesh Chaturthi and beyond. Let the music bring peace to your mind and the blessings of Vighnaharta Shri Ganesha into your day.
Song: Shri Ganeshay Dheemahi
Album: Vishwa Vinayaka
